[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation is 100 % (21/21).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "The 4‑point score is driven by the presence of a blue‑whitish veil (2 points), irregular dots and globules (1 point), and regression structures (1 point).",
  "A blue‑whitish veil is a confluent blue pigment with an overlying white haze.",
  "Irregular dots and globules are varied in size and unevenly distributed.",
  "Regression structures are white scar‑like areas, blue peppering, or both.",
  "The presence of these features, especially the blue‑whitish veil, is highly suggestive of melanoma despite the classifier’s benign call."
]
